## Description

"Non-directional speaker system using ceramic deflector.AMPHA means an acupressure point with both handles made in the ancient Greek period.It features a 20cm cone woofer in the low range, a 12cm cone mid-range in the middle range and a 2.5cm dome tweeter in the high range. Each unit is mounted horizontally and is surrounded by a ceramic deflector in the center for sound reproduction.There are 2variations of the appearance, black and white."
